48% hydrobromic acid.description: An aqueous HBr solution used to convert alcohols into their bromide counterparts.

ethanol.description: A common solvent and reactant, also the starting material for several bromide/cyanide syntheses.

sodium cyanide.description: A solid cyanide source used to substitute a leaving group and build nitriles.

ethyl bromide.description: A reactive alkyl bromide, useful both as a product and as an intermediate for further synthesis.

ethyl cyanide.description: A nitrile made by displacing bromide with cyanide -- a common synthesis target.

water.description: The universal solvent -- used for quenching, washing, and aqueous workups.

sodium bromide.description: A byproduct salt formed when cyanide displaces bromide in a nitrile synthesis.

methanol.description: A small, volatile alcohol -- the starting material for methyl bromide/cyanide syntheses.

methyl bromide.description: A volatile alkyl bromide made from methanol -- handle with care.

acetonitrile.description: A nitrile solvent and synthesis product, valued for its low water content when pure.

propionic acid.description: A short carboxylic acid used in esterification and general synthesis.

ethyl propionate.description: A fragrant ester made from propionic acid and ethanol -- prized for flavor work.
